testing_requirements.mandatory_data_testid_rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly follow light slate canvas (#F8FAFC) and pure white card (#FFFFFF) layout with dark navy vertical sidebar (#0F172A).
Use South African Rand symbol (R) for all financial numbers formatted with comma group separators (e.g. R 42,500.00).
Font imports MUST be added to public/index.html or index.css: Outfit for headings, Plus Jakarta Sans for UI, JetBrains Mono for monetary values and item codes.
Implement status badges with strict color mapping: Green (Emerald) for Paid/Completed/In Stock, Amber for Warning/Pending/Medium Stock, Red for Overdue/Low Stock/Outstanding.
Ensure responsiveness across Desktop (1440px+), Tablet (768px-1024px), and Mobile (375px+). Mobile layout must include a collapsible left drawer for sidebar navigation.
Add interactive state micro-animations (hover transition 150ms, active scaling/shadow, focus ring 2px).

All forms and tables must support complete workflow operations (adding customers, creating invoices, filtering stock, recording production, tracking driver deliveries, switching Zone 1 vs Zone 2 pricing).
